# Data Constraints

<!-- purpose: Where Data Constraints files live, the kinds they hold and every key they accept -->

*This page is generated from SWCraft's own definitions, and describes the version you have installed.*

Data constraints, one file each under `data_types/constraints/`: the physical limits a value is declared within, an element a type names by reference. One kind, `data_constr`, which an application type names as its `data_constr_ref`. The directory is mandatory and may be empty.

One file per `data_constraint`, in `data_types/constraints/` under the model root, named after its `name` and ending in `.yaml`. Where that file name is already taken by another element's file — compared without regard to case — the file gets the nearest free `~1`, `~2`, … instead; the element is identified by the `name` inside the file, never by its file name.

## `data_constr` { #data_constr }

<!-- purpose: Writing `data_constr` files in Data Constraints: each key, its type and default -->

A data constraint, emitted as a `DATA-CONSTR` in `/DataTypes/Constraints` with one rule of `PHYS-CONSTRS`: the physical limits an application type is declared within. An application type names one by its `data_constr_ref`, in place of an inline `range`. It holds no internal limits.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | — | The data constraint's identity; the file is named from it (`data_types/constraints/{name}.yaml`, or a suffixed name when another file collides case-insensitively) and is never what identifies it. Unique across the data constraints, must not be blank, and immutable; an element of another layer may carry the same name. |
| `min` | number | no | absent | The lower physical limit; omitted or `null` when there is none. An integer is held as the integer it is; NaN and ±Infinity are refused. |
| `max` | number | no | absent | The upper physical limit; omitted or `null` when there is none. An integer is held as the integer it is; NaN and ±Infinity are refused. |
| `level` | integer | no | absent | The rule's `CONSTR-LEVEL`, the category of the constraint (the lower the level, the more stringent the check); omitted or `null` when the rule states none. |
| `description` | string | no | `""` | Free text about the data constraint. Written into the generated ARXML as the element's `DESC`, exactly as held; the empty default writes none. |
| `package` | string | no | absent | The one sub-package of `/DataTypes/Constraints`, its layer's package, this data constraint is emitted in, a single SHORT-NAME segment: the data constraint and every reference to it take `/DataTypes/Constraints/{package}/`. Absent means `/DataTypes/Constraints` itself. It is held to the AUTOSAR Identifier rule. |
